maddeler.e:
أتكاشف (form VI)
# أَتَكَاشَفُ (ʔatakāšafu) /ʔa.ta.kaː.ʃa.fu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَكَاشَفَ (takāšafa)
# أَتَكَاشَفَ (ʔatakāšafa) /ʔa.ta.kaː.ʃa.fa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَكَاشَفَ (takāšafa)
# أَتَكَاشَفْ (ʔatakāšaf) /ʔa.ta.kaː.ʃaf/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَكَاشَفَ (takāšafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
